description: k71: a lock an interrupted sync left – the skill's SKILL.md written and owned, its entry marked partial, the skill's .gitignore never written. Through the CLI: status marks the entry (text and --json); check asks for a sync (exit 1, --json: declaredChanged for the mark, layoutChanged for the skill's .gitignore the lock lacks, varsChanged as no sync recorded its render inputs); the sync completes the item, names it updated and drops the mark; status and check afterwards find nothing left.
